summary:
• Strands Decider — a system‑one decision model that ranks options and scores them on Apple‑silicon Macs, enabling low‑latency branching in agentic workflows.
• Claude Code — Anthropic’s coding assistant for desktop and CLI, now with unified policy keys and auto‑compacting context to reduce token waste in long sessions.
• Whirl — an open‑source full‑stack AI chat platform built with Next.js and Convex that provides modular memory, tool plugins and easy self‑hosting for custom assistants.
• Autonomous FPS Decompiler — using Claude Max and Codex Pro to decompile a shooter into C++, proving multi‑model orchestration can deliver production code.
• Hermes Agent — an open‑source local LLM stack that lets developers run multi‑billion‑parameter models on Mac hardware, offering privacy‑first inference and reducing reliance on cloud APIs.
• X API Exhibit — a showcase of apps and Grok Bot templates that use X data, helping developers discover integration patterns and lower entry barriers.
